subject: MAP kickoff: Cerberus Private deployment — connectivity, owners, timeline
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Austin Reed <austin.reed@cerberushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff: Cerberus Private deployment — connectivity, owners, timeline

Hi Austin / Maya —

Thanks for the time earlier this week. Per our call, were starting a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align owners and a tentative eval/close timeline for a Cerberus private (VPC/on-prem) deployment of Redwood. This thread will be our kickoff + single source for network/VPN and IAM/KMS owners.

Quick context and asks:
1) Attachments: draft MAP and an initial network topology (see files below). Please review and flag anything missing.
2) Can Cerberus confirm the network contact and whether you prefer site-to-site VPN or a dedicated transit/VPN appliance pattern?
3) Please identify the IAM/KMS owner on your side (we need KMS requirements for key wrapping and audit logs).
4) Timeline: we propose a 2-week evaluation window starting Jan 18 — target commercial decision by Feb 1. If procurement needs SOW earlier, call that out and well prioritize.

Next steps (Redwood): well share a filled MAP with milestones, a short checklist for network prep, and a preflight document for PKI/KMS assumptions.

Attachments: cerberus_map_draft_v0.3.pdf (MAP draft), network_topology_v1.png (initial sketch), kms_requirements.xlsx (KMS questions)

Proposed internal owners (Redwood):
- Marissa Cole: POC lead / commercial
- Rishi Malhotra: network & VPN integration
- Neha Kapoor: KMS / compliance questions
- Dev Patel: deployment topology & runtime configs

Austin — can you confirm Cerberus point people (Maya/Rajesh/etc.) and whether the Jan 18 start works? If Jan 18 is tight, propose earliest available date.

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

---
From: Austin Reed <austin.reed@cerberushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Li <maya.li@cerberushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Cerberus Private deployment — connectivity, owners, timeline

Logan — thanks, this looks good.

Confirming Cerberus side:
- Maya Li (Cloud Infra) will drive network and infra execution (maya.li@cerberushealth.com)
- Rajesh Kumar (Security) will be KMS/compliance owner (rajesh.kumar@cerberushealth.com)

We prefer site-to-site IPsec VPN to start (we may revisit transit later). Jan 18 start is feasible, but procurement has asked for an SOW + estimate by Jan 20 to start internal approvals. If you can deliver a short SOW and cost estimate before Jan 20 that would help.

Weve attached our internal baseline network diagram (separate PDF). Ill share Rajesh on the thread once hes back from travel this afternoon.

Thanks — Austin
Austin Reed
Head of Cloud Ops | Cerberus Health
austin.reed@cerberushealth.com | +1 617-555-0222

Attachments: cerberus_internal_net_baseline.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Austin Reed <austin.reed@cerberushealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Cerberus Private deployment — connectivity, owners, timeline

Hi Austin / Maya —

Great — thanks for confirming owners. Looping in internal owners explicitly so actions are clear:
- Neha: lead on KMS, compliance questionnaire, and SOC/crypto controls
- Rishi: network lead for VPN design and site-to-site testing plan
- Dev: deployment topology and runtime config (autoscale, GPU tenancy, private endpoints)

Well fast-follow a concise SOW and the MAP milestone table (Ill target a draft SOW and cost estimate by EOD Jan 18, but Logan — can we try for Jan 19 to meet Cerberuss Jan 20 procurement ask?).

Action items assigned here:
- Austin / Maya: share any required CIDR ranges, firewall whitelist windows, and whether you have a transit gateway. (due Jan 12)
- Neha: prepare KMS requirements checklist (due Jan 14)
- Rishi: draft VPN test plan and staging IP flipbook (due Jan 15)
- Logan / Dev: prepare a short SOW and estimated units for the 2-week eval (target Jan 19)

If folks are good, can we schedule a 30-minute network sync on Jan 13 to walk topology? Propose Jan 13 10:00 AM PT.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Austin Reed <austin.reed@cerberushealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Cerberus Private deployment — connectivity, owners, timeline

Folks —

Quick KMS note from my side:
- We need to confirm whether Cerberus requires customer-managed keys (CMKs) in their cloud provider KMS or if Redwood-managed keys with CMK import are acceptable. If CMKs required, please confirm key rotation policy and whether HSM-backed keys are a must.
- Audit log retention: we typically surface key usage logs to the customer for 180 days by default; if you need longer retention well need an ops play to export logs to your SIEM.
- Please fill the attached kms_requirements.xlsx and return to me; Ill convert answers into the KMS section of the SOW.

Im available for a quick call Jan 14 if Rajesh or Maya want to walk through the KMS questions.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Austin Reed <austin.reed@cerberushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: Cerberus Private deployment — connectivity, owners, timeline

Austin / Maya —

Thanks for confirming site-to-site IPsec; well plan for the standard IKEv2 configuration with AES-256-GCM and SHA-2. Two quick asks to prep the VPN staging window:
1) Please confirm a staging CIDR (we need a /24 placeholder for the POC) and at least one public IP for your VPN gateway.
2) Let us know any MTU adjustments or packet filtering your edge appliance enforces — that helps avoid open/fragmentation issues during KV cache warmups.

Ive uploaded a simple flipbook and the initial topology PNG to the shared Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_shared_drive_link (network_topology_v1.png).

Next steps summary:
- Redwood prepares SOW + cost estimate (target Jan 19)
- Cerberus provides CIDRs, VPN gateway IP and Rajesh for KMS questions (target Jan 12)
- Jan 13 10:00 AM PT network sync (tentative)

Ill also include NetSecure as a potential VPN validation partner on the sync in case Cerberus prefers an external engineer for gateway setup.

Rishi
Principal Network Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: network_topology_v1.png, cerberus_map_draft_v0.3.pdf
